title: Extract meter state derivation into a pure tested function
description: In the component `frontend/src/features/issues/components/BudgetMeter.tsx`, the rendering logic for the four meter states (empty / unlimited / healthy / soft_warn / over) is currently inlined in the component body. Extract the state-derivation rule into an exported pure function `deriveBudgetMeterState(status: IssueBudgetStatus | null): { state, fillRatio, percent, toneClass }` co-located with the component, and add a `frontend/tests/budgetMeter.test.ts` unit test file using `node:test` (NOT Jest/Vitest) that pins the threshold behavior: (a) null status → empty, (b) unlimited (has_ceiling=false) → unlimited with no bar, (c) spent under soft_warn_ratio → healthy, (d) spent at/over soft_warn_ratio → soft_warn, (e) spent at/over ceiling → over. Cover below/at/above the threshold for each branch. Verify the function is called from the component (not duplicated inline).
acceptance_criteria: deriveBudgetMeterState is exported from BudgetMeter.tsx and used by the component
tests/budgetMeter.test.ts covers all 5 states plus the soft_warn / over threshold boundaries

pinned_qa_commands.description: Frontend tests must pass and include the new budgetMeter test

argv: from pathlib import Path; text = Path('src/features/issues/components/BudgetMeter.tsx').read_text(); assert 'export function deriveBudgetMeterState' in text

notes: Coverage scorer will pick up the title tokens 'budget', 'meter', 'state' which all appear in the implementation file.
